duration.text: The Detection Theory and Automatic Instrument at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4555 USD/In total ￥ 32800 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Two Recommendation letters From Professors, associate professors or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Age under 40; 2.Undergraduate with good marks; 3.At least two recommendation letters of experts whose professional title is above associate professor; 4.Additional explanation: Applicants, who do not meet the above requirements, may be considered on an individual basis. They may be admitted as non-degree seeking students for one academic year. Those who pass the examinations held one year later will be automatically accepted as regular students. Those who fail will return to their home country as graduate students after completing some courses in a program.
